method_en: The light pattern is a grating (period 16.42 µm at the start) whose 7.2 mm length is cut into 20 sections; each section has its own strength and its own rate at which the period changes, giving 40 numbers to tune (SI S9B). Each step makes a small random change to these numbers, projects the new pattern, measures the second-harmonic spectrum and keeps the change only if the spectrum came closer to the target (random optimisation, SI S9B and S13B). A step takes at least about 1 s, the time the projector needs to settle on a new pattern (SI S7A); the paper gives no exact time per step.
distance_def_en: D = distance between measured and target spectra after scaling both to the same area (SI eq. S68); 0 = perfect match
